sentences.text: Holbotia is an extinct genus containing only one species and belongs to the bird group Enantiornithes.
This animal is classified under the class Reptilia.
The genus Holbotia was described by Zelenkov and Averianov in 2016.
The genus name Holbotia refers to the location where the holotype fossil was discovered.
The species name ponomarenkoi honors Alexander G. Ponomarenko, the paleoentomologist who discovered the type specimen.
Holbotia lived in Mongolia during the Early Cretaceous epoch.
It lived between 132.6 and 121.4 million years ago during the Hauterivian to Barremian stages.
